India Mandates Indian Standard Time as Single Official Reference

The Indian government has notified rules making the Indian Standard Time (IST) the sole official time reference across the country. This mandate, effective from March 2027, requires a 180-day window for compliance. The government stated the need for a common time reference has grown due to increasing reliance on digital and technology-based systems. The initiative is framed as a move towards synchronizing digital systems and self-reliance in timekeeping.
